interface.shortDescription: 草稿、字幕、音频与特效，Rust 单栈编排
interface.longDescription: Cross-host JianYing automation through one checksum-verified Rust jianying-cli Runtime Adapter. The plugin compiles jianying-job/v2, preserves task IDs and structured errors, verifies capability and skill locks, and distinguishes editable drafts, proxy previews, playback evidence, and approval-gated native export.

Assemble my episode clips into a JianYing draft
